title: Output Layer
body:
[[Output]]

---

The last layer, the one the [[Loss Function]] is computed on. Its width and its
[[Activation Function]] are both dictated by the task rather than chosen freely:

| Task | Units | Activation | Loss |
|---|---|---|---|
| [[Binary Classification]] | 1 | [[Sigmoid]], giving $P(\text{class }1)$ | [[Log Loss]] |
| multi-class ($k$ classes) | $k$ | softmax, giving a distribution over the $k$ | [[Cross-Entropy Loss]] |
| regression | 1 | none, leave it linear | squared error |

Softmax is the multi-class [[Sigmoid]]: exponentiate every output and divide by the total, so the
$k$ numbers are non-negative and sum to 1. That is a [[Probability Distribution]], which is what
lets [[Cross-Entropy]] be the loss. On [[MNIST]] this layer is 10 units, one per digit.

See [[Hidden Layer]] for the layers before it and [[Input Layer]] for the one at the front.
